title: General Services contract management audit
finding: The report states no detailed audit findings. Its observations include pricing-index inconsistencies and incomplete invoice support. Scope principally covers FY2021–September 2023, with limited FY2024 testing.
implication: Prioritize a fictional price-variance case and an invoice evidence checklist; do not portray historical observations as proven current deficiencies.

title: Beacon procurement portal announcement
finding: Houston announced Beacon for solicitations effective February 1, 2025, while retaining SAP Business Network supplier registration for transactions.
implication: Keep sourcing, agreement evidence and downstream transactions separate. No Oracle or specific SAP API version is assumed.

title: AP 5-11: procurement exceptions
finding: The policy calls for CPO discussion within eight hours of an incident and a completed emergency justification within 24 hours. The CPO determines whether an emergency purchase is warranted.
implication: Demonstrate evidence timing and escalation. Do not automate emergency qualification, awards or monetary authority; validate current policy with its owner.

title: AP 5-13: contractor performance
finding: This policy describes contractor-performance evaluations and applicability exceptions. Regular written evaluations are generally at least quarterly, subject to policy scope.
implication: Show a reviewed performance artifact in a synthetic renewal case; the 90-day notice interval is invented, not city policy.

title: AP 5-8: informal procurements
finding: The dated policy favors the electronic bidding platform; direct-quote exceptions require documented justification and prior approval. It also addresses receiving and invoice verification.
implication: Do not build a shortcut around competitive sourcing. Monetary thresholds are not executable rules in this demo.

title: Pay or Play program forms
finding: The forms distinguish acknowledgement, election, subcontractor and waiver documentation. The Workforce Utilization Module supports program reporting and invoicing.
implication: Treat applicability and required evidence as an OBO-owned review. Do not collect employee health information or infer benefit eligibility.

title: OBO contract compliance
finding: Published compliance responsibilities span participation/payment monitoring, labor matters and related contract oversight.
implication: Maintain an applicability record and source versions. No participation-goal, certification or legal-compliance scoring is implemented.

title: Public report on MWBE litigation
finding: A news report describes a federal ruling affecting race-based aspects of the program. The current order, any stay and implementation instructions were not verified in this research.
implication: Require current city legal guidance before implementing any affected policy. This demonstration uses no race-based selection or numeric participation rules.

title: docusign May 2026 release notes
finding: The release notes describe Workflow Builder naming and capabilities including the HTTP web request extension and workflow variable features.
implication: Propose a typed request from Workflow Builder to PUG; confirm the sandbox entitlement, security options and response mapping before connecting.

title: Agreement Manager API FAQ
finding: The vendor describes API access to agreement ingestion and querying, with developer testing and production plan considerations.
implication: Use agreement metadata as reviewable evidence. Fixture math and checkboxes in this example do not prove extraction quality or a live IAM connection.

title: Configure agreement types and fields
finding: Configuration packages support agreement types, fields and extraction configuration; changes can affect existing configuration and require reprocessing for existing agreements.
implication: Version configuration, test on a dedicated synthetic corpus and review a dry run. Never bulk-overwrite a shared tenant as part of this demo.

title: Published HCD procurement contract
finding: A published contract package contains docusign envelope identifiers. This is historical evidence of eSignature use, not proof of present IAM licensing or integration architecture.
implication: Tell a beyond-signature story without implying city endorsement, current entitlement or access to city systems.

title: Houston procurement visual identity
finding: The public page uses a city-seal masthead, a skyline banner and departmental resource navigation.
implication: Use the actual city assets and familiar department naming in a clearly labeled staff-portal concept.

title: City website typography stylesheet
finding: The published stylesheet imports Fjalla One and Open Sans.
implication: Bundle licensed fonts locally and use the observed heading/body pairing.

title: City website light-theme stylesheet
finding: Published styles include departmental blue #34587F and Open Sans body styling.
implication: Adapt observed visual conventions, without claiming a formal brand-standard certification.
